GRADE 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

2. About Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate vocabulary to construct sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

3. About Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

5. About Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to direct and inferential questions from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension completely.
   C. Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

6. About Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use the dictionary to find the meaning of vocabulary used in texts for understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension completely.
   C. Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

7. About Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to direct and inferential questions from a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension completely.
   C. Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

9. About Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify features of a Short Message Service (SMS) for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS completely.
   C. Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

10. About Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. create an SMS text with appropriate features for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS completely.
   C. Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

11. About Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify features of a Short Message Service (SMS) for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS completely.
   C. Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

13. About Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

14. About Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate vocabulary to construct sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

15. About Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

17. About Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. select appropriate materials from the library for extensive reading,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills completely.
   C. Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

18. About Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. read texts based on a specific topic from a library for general information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills completely.
   C. Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

19. About Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. access specific information from the internet for reading,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills completely.
   C. Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

21. About Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. outline parts of an essay from samples,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing completely.
   C. Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

22. About Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. compose an essay on a specific theme for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing completely.
   C. Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

23. About Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. outline parts of an essay from samples,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing completely.
   C. Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

25. About Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

26. About Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate vocabulary to construct sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

27. About Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to information from oral texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

29. About Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise key points from texts after reading,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building completely.
   C. Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

30. About Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. create a glossary of new vocabulary from texts for communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building completely.
   C. Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

31. About Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise key points from texts after reading,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building completely.
   C. Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

SECTION B: Short Answers

8. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension in a conversation with a classmate.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS in a conversation with a classmate.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building in a conversation with a classmate.
